name: sensei
description: A lean maintenance cycle for Claude Code skill plugins: plan a new plugin or a change to one (meditate), set up a plugin repo (prepare), keep its backlog and changelog (log), create or change a skill from a real case with checks, independent reviews and trigger tests (train), release a version (graduate), show a newcomer where to start (introduce), and evaluate a skill made elsewhere before adopting sensei (spar).
